crossRefs.note: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him…
Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake…
Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
Therefore as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; so death passed to all men, because all…
We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were…

translations.web: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
translations.bsb: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.
translations.kjv: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive
translations.asv: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity; And in sin did my mother conceive me.
